title: Carrot Cake
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Neem garam doodh (Lukewarm milk) ½ Cup

steps.instruction: In bowl,add all-purpose flour,caster sugar,nutmeg powder,cinnamon powder,salt,baking soda,mix well and set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,bareek cheeni,jaifil powder,darchini powder,namak aur baking soda dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In lukewarm milk,add lemon juice,mix well and let it rest for few minutes.Butter milk is ready & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Neem garam doodh mein lemon juice dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein aur kuch dair kliya chor dein.Butter milk tayyar hai & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add eggs and beat well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein anday dal ker ache tarhan beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add vegetable oil,prepared butter milk,vanilla essence and beat again.
steps.romanUrdu: Vegetable oil,tayyar butter milk aur vanilla essence dal ker dubara beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add dry flour mixture and beat until well combined (don't over beat).
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka dry maida ka mixture dal dein aur combine hunay tak beat kertay rahein (don't over beat).

steps.instruction: Add carrots,walnuts and fold gently with the help of the spatula.
steps.romanUrdu: Gajar aur akhrot dal dein aur spatula ki madad sa gently fold ker lein.

steps.instruction: Grease 8” inch baking pan with cooking oil,place butter paper and pour cake batter in prepared baking pan.
steps.romanUrdu: 8” inch baking pan ko cooking oil sa grease ker ka butter paper laga lein aur tayyar cake batter dal dein.

steps.instruction: Bake in preheated oven at 180 C for 40-50 minutes or until the cake pulls away from the side of the pans and a toothpick inserted in the center of the cakes comes out clean.
steps.romanUrdu: Preheated oven mein 180 C per 40-50 minutes kliya bake ker lein.

steps.instruction: Remove the cake from the oven and run a knife around the edges to loosen them from the sides of the pan.
steps.romanUrdu: Cake ko oven sa nikal lein aur cake ki sides per knife dal ker ghooma lein ta ka pan ki sides lose ho jayein.

steps.instruction: Transfer the cake to the wire rack and let it cool.
steps.romanUrdu: Cake ko wire rack per rakh dein aur thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add butter and beat until fluffy.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein makhan dal dein aur fluffy hunay tak beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add cream cheese and beat until smooth.
steps.romanUrdu: Cream cheese dal dein aur smooth hunay tak beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add vanilla essence and icing sugar,beat again and refrigerate until use.
steps.romanUrdu: Vanilla essence aur icing sugar dal ker dubara beat ker lein aur istamal kernay tak refrigerate ker lein.

steps.instruction: With the help of the cake knife,horizontally cut two layers of cake.
steps.romanUrdu: Cake knife ki madad sa cake ko do horizontally layers mein cut ker lein.

steps.instruction: On cake tray,place cake layer and apply frosting.
steps.romanUrdu: Cake tray per cake ki layer rakh dein aur frosting laga lein.

steps.instruction: Place another cake layer and cover the cake with cream cheese frosting & chopped walnuts.
steps.romanUrdu: Cake ki dosri layer rakh dein aur cake ko cream cheese frosting aur chopped akhrot sa cover ker lein.
